coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell or box: its printed edges. Tick box: the printed square.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters and drawn rules (cand/b002.json); "o" boxes measured as ink at 400 dpi; caption cells measured from caption bottom to rule; every page looked at at 100 dpi; overlays looked at.

signing.kind: Order form (Carey Credit Income Fund - I) converted to landscape pages. The investor and a joint investor initial twelve representations in two labelled columns and sign page 8; the custodian signs and guarantees on page 9; the registered representative completes and signs pages 9-10. No issuer acceptance block.
signing.note: Tick boxes and initials places are printed as the letter "o" (12 pt for tick boxes, 24 pt for initials).

sure_per_page.4: sure of the tick boxes and the named blanks; two extra short rules (under the UGMA state blank and under "Other") are kept, marked
sure_per_page.9: sure; the medallion guarantee rule is read as a third-party signature place (marked)

1: "FOR PROSPECTUS DATED ____": the issuer completes it before sending
the short rule after the section number "1." and the long rule after the section title (decorative)
2: section rules after "2." and the title
the short vertical tick marks at the left of each cell (cell edges, part of the cells)
4: underlined headings (Non-Qualified Account, Trust Ownership, Entity Ownership, Qualified Account) and the underlined word "one"
the rule under the entity block (a separator)
5: the second, thicker rule drawn under each "City/State/ZIP" rule is the same blank
7: state-specific notes in the left column
the rule between the general and state-specific representations
